source_requirement.description: Entering a scanned item and quantity creates a SalesLineItem for the current Sale and the scanned Item, recording that quantity and its subtotal. The current sale must exist and be incomplete; the item must exist with positive stock, and the entered quantity must not exceed that stock. The newly created sales line is included in the sales-line collection and becomes the current sale line. The item stock is reduced by the entered quantity, and the operation returns true.
